name: grimoire
description: Grimoire's catalog as Claude Code plugins: skills, subagents and MCP servers. Rules and hook tools are installed with the grimoire CLI.

plugins.name: adr-writer
plugins.description: Writes, numbers and supersedes architecture decision records, and answers why a decision was made

plugins.name: project-docs
plugins.description: A read-only MCP server that lists, reads and searches a project's docs and ADRs

plugins.name: rust-cli
plugins.description: Part of Grimoire's `rust-cli` bundle: installs the `adr-writer` and `project-docs` plugins. Left out: `conventional-commits` (a rule) is not published as a plugin; install it with the grimoire CLI. The whole bundle: Conventional Commits, architecture decision records and a read-only docs server for Rust CLI projects. Needs `grimoire-mcp-project-docs` on PATH.

plugins.name: security-baseline
plugins.description: Part of Grimoire's `security-baseline` bundle: installs the `security-reviewer` plugin. Left out: `secret-guard` (a tool) is not published as a plugin; install it with the grimoire CLI. The whole bundle: A read-only security reviewer agent plus hooks that keep likely secrets out of tool calls and prompts.

plugins.name: security-reviewer
plugins.description: Read-only security review of code and diffs, reporting each finding with evidence
